title: SeventeenAgency Scroll Animation
description: Infinite-scrolling contact page (Lenis infinite mode) where the contact-info section is cloned 10x into a seamless loop: two scrubbed ScrollTriggers per row animate its CSS gap from 1rem to 10rem and back as the row crosses the viewport center, while a fixed vignetted still at screen center cycles through seven captured-light images each time a new row locks onto the center.

images.desc: wisp of white smoke curling on a black background
images.role: cycling center still 1 (shown on load) — vignetted into the dark

images.desc: magenta neon light streaks on black
long-exposure light trails looping over a dark surface
orange spark trails spinning against black
violet flame licking upward on black
clear water splash frozen mid-air on black

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para una página de contacto de scroll infinito donde los datos se expanden al pasar por el centro y un icono 3D cromado va cambiando.

motion.motion_signature: each row's inline column gap is scrub-expanded 1rem → 10rem (5rem under 1000px) as it approaches the fixed viewport centre, then scrub-collapsed back to 1rem 150px later — an expand/contract pulse per row, riding an infinitely looping Lenis scroll; no tween interpolation at all, progress is written straight to style.gap every frame

review.comment: En Mobile está completamente descuadrado el texto con las imágenes y hace que pierdas el efecto por completo y en desktop también pero muy ligeramente, está un pelín más arriba. Y el vídeo hay que repetirlo cuando lo corrijamos un poco más fluido.
